I made a one-line fix in `packages/babel-generator/src/source-map.ts`. I haven't built the package or run any tests, and I didn't add a test for this case.

**Cause:** when you pass an `inputSourceMap` that has no `sourcesContent` field (the map in the issue doesn't have one), `TraceMap` leaves `sourcesContent` as `undefined`. The generator then read `this._inputMap.sourcesContent[i]`, which threw `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '0')`.

**Fix:** that read is now `this._inputMap.sourcesContent?.[i]`. When the input map has no source contents, the generated map should have no content for those sources either, rather than crashing. I didn't check what the output map looks like in that case; I expect a `null` entry once it's serialized to JSON.
